real_player_evidence: 2 players. 2026-10-24: stalled at the first sale after choosing Keep. 2026-10-26 (founder, Android): reveal from the production line showed no bottle, no way to make salt by hand, small buttons. All fixed in 3.7.1. Too small to conclude anything about fun; see LEARNINGS.
build: Vite + TypeScript. three.js 3D world (src/render3d) under a 2D canvas UI layer (src/scenes). Pure rules in src/core (unit-tested).
how_to_run: npm install && npm run dev  (open http://localhost:5173, ?reset=1 wipes the save, ?seed=N, ?speed=N)
how_to_test: npm test ; npm run build ; npx vite preview --port 4173 & node tools/playtest.mjs --trips 6 --skill 0.7 --shots (playtests run against the preview build; HMR reloads break bot runs on the dev server)
current_objective: Get real players onto build 3.0 and learn whether the island business (staff + puzzles) brings them back (EXP-006) without hurting the fishing fun.
biggest_known_problem: Zero real-player evidence. The playable link and analytics now exist; the blocker is getting 5-10 casual players to open it.

[SIM] Progression sim (tools/sim.ts): story finishes at all skills 0.4-0.8. Reef at 10-30 min, Abyss at 2.4-3.3 h. It caught and fixed a perfect-catch softlock and an economy that maxed gear in 40 min.
[SIM] Browser bot on the real UI: 10 trips, lagoon story → Turtle Buddy relic → sailed to the Reef, 6 missions, no errors.
Build 2.1: first reveal shows only 'Sell' until the first sale, market hand pointer, js_error telemetry, analyzer reports errors, seas fished, tangles and stored-not-sold.

Build 2.2: quality tiers + FPS governor (weak-device proxy 2-3 → 15-23 fps), service worker offline cache + split three.js chunk + PWA manifest, accounts: claude.ai cloud save live in the playtest; Google/Apple/Facebook login built on Firebase and dormant until the founder creates the project (docs/TECHNICAL.md has the steps).

Hero Lan, mentor Bà Năm, sidekick Rùa, rival Mr. Tốc, guides Chú Tư and Cô Hạnh. 12 skippable Story Spine scenes across 5 chapters, a giver and reason for every mission, 3D portraits, Rùa rides the boat. docs/STORY.md is the bible; EXP-004 measures skip rate.

Build 2.6 (founder feedback: catching got boring): food-chain puzzle. Fish have levels 1-4; landing level L makes a level L+1 fish hungry (rises within reach, true colours, bites fast). Chain ×2/×3/×4 pays 16/36/64 coins. Ladder HUD, level chips, Bà Năm scene, tutorial goal 'Chain 2 fish'. [SIM] Phú Quốc finishes in 4-7 trips (was 8-22); bot made 11 links in 6 trips, no errors.

Build 3.0 (founder direction D-012): island business. 7x9 Phú Quốc plot map to buy and discover (cove, salt flat, old pier, treasure, free hire); 8 buildings; staff (Fisher, Salt Maker, Brewer, Shopkeeper) who work in every scene and offline (4 h cap); staff Lv 1-5 trained only after clearing puzzles; 3 puzzle sections (Fishing food-chain, Salt channels, Shop orders) with a 100-level track and 5 levels each, all verified solvable. [SIM] ~2x income, story ~15% faster. tools/island-qa.mjs passes; bot regression clean.

Build 3.1 (founder feedback): the main screen zooms from the village out to the whole island estate in 3D: plots (owned / buyable under thin cloud / hidden under cloud), every building, staff animated at their jobs, customers walking to the shop, real staff output floating up. Pinch, wheel and ± zoom, drag to pan, tap a plot to manage it. Overview ~270 draw calls after merging (was ~720).

Build 3.2 (founder feedback + reference images): the main screen is one continuous low-poly island (traced, smoothed coastline; painted top; grass cliff; wide beach; lagoon shallows; shore rocks). Owned land bright and fenced, land for sale wilder with signs, specials disguised until bought. Village moved to the north coast (map v2) with a tested save migration (land refunded, buildings and staff relocated). ~266 draw calls in the overview.

Build 3.3 (founder feedback): Market reachable from the island view, Manage and the Sauce Shop; staff wages and building upkeep with a ledger (income/wages/upkeep/net per hour), unpaid staff pause; Brand ladder (6 stages, ×1.0 to ×1.85, reputation from sales); Mực the Phú Quốc Ridgeback: 3 tutorial goals after the first sale, 4 scenes, rides the boat and barks at real rare fish. Bot completed the dog chain in 8 trips with no errors.

Build 3.4 (founder request): Business Report (Earn / Costs / Boost) with a linked fix on every line, idle-worker detection that names the real bottleneck, how-to-spend-less tips; tourism (Tour Office, Tour Guides, attraction from what you built, tourists walking in 3D, souvenirs); festival and radio ad; export orders at the Trading Post. Wage growth cut to +15%/level.

Puzzle levels 6-10 in every section (generated, seed-stable salt fields; harder fishing chains; 6-customer shop orders); staff can train to Lv 10. All 30 levels are verified solvable by tests; bot regression clean.

Build 3.7 (founder request): native iOS + Android apps with Capacitor 8 (D-017). android/ + ios/ projects, Android back button, save on background + staff catch-up on resume, haptics, safe areas for notch/home bar, portrait lock, system-browser sign-in with deep link, in-app account deletion (SQL function tested in PGlite; browser e2e passes), crisp 1024 icon + adaptive icon + splash. CI builds the Android APK/AAB and an iOS simulator build; CI run #3 builds both (Android APK/AAB 9.2 MB, iOS simulator app 3.4 MB); not yet run on a real phone.

New procedural beach soundscape: uneven waves with foam, sea bed, breeze, a rare distant gull, optional slow D-pentatonic pluck melody with echo (Settings → Music); sound/music choices now persist. The hand stops pointing at Mực after the first tap.

analytics: Each signed-in player at Contributor level or above (or an org member) writes one summary doc to plays/<viewer id> in the artifact store; only the owner can read it. Pull: ArtifactData list collection=plays out_dir=<dir>, then node tools/analyze-plays.mjs <dir>. Viewers without write access still play; their data stays local only.
how_to_publish: node tools/build-artifact.mjs, then Artifact publish of dist-artifact/mam-village.html to the URL above (pass url from a new session after an Artifact read).
